title: Biomes O' Plenty | Mizuno's Texture Pack
description: Mizunos 16 Craft texture pack for biomes o' plenty
body:
Hi guyss!! I am such a control freak, and I absolutely hate when my game doesn’t match...so I made a Biomes O’ Plenty texture pack to help everything blend in with my game.

This resource pack adds a bunch of new textures for Biomes O’ Plenty, making the mod fit much better with a Mizuno-style Minecraft world. This was actually the first texture pack I ever made (around a year ago) and I’ve been using it privately ever since, so it may not be perfect. I promise I’m much better at texture packs now :’)

If you spot anything that looks a bit funky, broken, or out of place, please let me know and I’ll try to fix it as soon as I can.

I have mainly been using this pack on Minecraft 1.21.1, but I have updated it to work with  26.1.2. Older or newer versions may also work, but if you need a specific version, feel free to ask and I’m more than happy to have a go.

✦ Important Credits ✦

All of these textures are based on textures from Mizuno’s 16 Craft and Modern Mizuno’s. I have recoloured/altered them so that they match the everything in the Biomes O' Plenty mod. Please go support the original creators and download their packs here:

**Mizuno’s 16 Craft:**
[Mizuno's 16 Craft](https://resourcepack.net/mizunos-16-craft-resource-pack/)

**Modern Mizuno’s:**
[Modern Mizuno's](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/modern-mizunos)

This pack only adds textures for the [Biomes O' Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty) mod, so Biomes O’ Plenty is required.

I have also slightly altered/recoloured the Biomes O’ Plenty section of ShorkBee’s Mizuno’s Better Leaves pack to make it fit better with my retexture. Please go download their pack for the base game better leaves here:

**ShorkBee’s Mizuno’s Better Leaves:**
[Mizuno Better Leaves](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/mizuno-better-leaves)

All credit for the better leaves go to ShorkBee.

✦ Permissions ✦

Please do not reupload this pack as your own without my permission.

You are welcome to alter the pack for personal use. However, because these textures are not fully mine, if you want to publicly share edited versions or use parts of this pack in your own project, you will need to ask the original creators for permission too, including [ShorkBee](https://modrinth.com/user/ShorkBee) and [Garden Gals](https://modrinth.com/organization/NGq4CQCR) where relevant.

Thank you so much for downloading and supporting me. I hope you enjoy the pack !!
